subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 5: word families - groups and rearranges words (bin, pin, tin; bed, fed, shed; why, my, fly)

show.line: Word families end the same. Bin, pin, tin. Bed, fed, shed!

rounds.prompt: Which word is in the same family as bin?
rounds.praise: Yes! Bin, tin. The in family.

rounds.prompt: Which word is in the same family as bed?
rounds.praise: Yes! Bed, fed. The ed family.

rounds.prompt: Which word is in the same family as my?

hints: Look at the end of the word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will put this in the in family.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Bed goes in the in family!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bed goes in the ed family.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Bed ends with ed. The ed family!

parent_line: Can sort words into families like bin, pin, tin and bed, fed, shed.
